title.value: Fill out a Form 1040 with computer use

introduction.value: A tester gave Claude Computer Use data stored on disk and checked whether it could find the fields and fill a simplified Form 1040 accurately.

method.value: The tester put made-up tax documents (W-2, 1099s, 1098, property tax and charity receipts) in a folder shared between Claude Computer Use and his Mac. He prompted it to fill a simplified web version of the 1040 in Firefox from that folder. It listed the files, then took screenshots of the form. He had to tell it to re-read the prompt after it asked for information he'd already given.

outcome.value: The excerpt ends as Claude starts working on the form, so the accuracy results are not in this post. They are in the full blog post it links to.

notes.value: A PDF editor version didn't work for Claude Computer Use, which the author suspects is a driver or compatibility issue. He switched to a browser-based form.
